Follow the Conventional Commits format strictly.
Use the following format: <type>(<scope>): <short description>

Allowed types: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, chore, ci.
- The first line (subject) must not exceed 50 characters.
- Use the imperative mood (e.g., "Add feature" instead of "Added feature").
- Separate the subject from the body with a blank line.
- Use bullet points in the body to list explicit changes.
